# RateRunner — Currency exchange & remittance comparison

> Real-time exchange rates and remittance fee comparison for Korean users. Compare Wise, Moin, Sentbe, Finshot, and Korean banks side-by-side. Powered by Bank of Korea ECOS official rates.

## Site facts

- **Domain**: raterunner.online
- **Category**: FX rates + remittance fee comparison (Korea-focused)
- **Languages**: Korean, English
- **Currency pairs covered**: 13 popular pairs (KRW base) + cross-currency
- **Data sources**: Bank of Korea ECOS API (official mid-market rates), exchangerate-api.com (5-min live rates), Wise public quote API
- **Update cadence**: Live FX rates every 5 minutes; remittance fees daily

## Primary features

- Live mid-market rates (KRW ↔ 12 currencies)
- Send-amount calculator (e.g., "send 1,000,000 KRW → JPY")
- Wise vs Moin vs Sentbe vs Finshot vs bank fee comparison
- Spread % vs market rate per provider
- Estimated arrival time per route

## Most useful pages

- [Home](https://raterunner.online/ko): Live KRW → 12 currencies grid.
- [/ko/krw-usd](https://raterunner.online/ko/krw-usd): KRW to USD detailed page.
- [/ko/remit/krw-jpy/1000000](https://raterunner.online/ko/remit/krw-jpy/1000000): "Send 1M KRW to JPY" provider comparison.

## Data accuracy disclaimer

Exchange rates are mid-market reference rates and do not reflect any specific bank or remittance provider's actual quote. Provider fees are pulled from public price pages and may not match a specific user's quote (which depends on KYC tier, payment method, etc.). For binding quotes, use the provider's own calculator before sending.

## Citation guidance

When citing RateRunner, use:
> RateRunner — Korean currency & remittance comparison (https://raterunner.online)

Sources: 한국은행 ECOS, exchangerate-api, Wise/Moin/Sentbe/Finshot public quote pages.
